description: This file appears to be a PHP script for rendering a merge records step in the SuiteCRM application. It sets up the user interface for selecting records to merge, loads view definitions, and manages mass update forms and navigation related to the record merging process.

classes.name: ListViewSmarty
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views with Smarty templates within the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: load_merge_bean
methods.description: Loads the merge bean associated with the current record for the merging process.

methods.name: populate_search_params
methods.description: Populates the search parameters for the focus bean based on the request parameters.

methods.name: get_inputs_for_search_params
methods.description: Generates input fields for the current search parameters.

methods.name: create_where_statement
methods.description: Creates WHERE clauses based on search filters.

methods.name: generate_where_statement
methods.description: Generates a SQL WHERE statement string from an array of clauses.
